name: Swift Charts dashboard
description: Dashboard building blocks with Swift Charts: stat tiles, a trend line over time and a category bar chart, with accessible summaries.
usage: Map the app's data to `ChartPoint(label:date:value:)` values in a view model. Compose a dashboard with `DashboardCard(title:) { ... }` containing `StatTile(title:value:systemImage:)`, `TrendChart(points:valueLabel:)` (values over dates) and `CategoryBarChart(points:valueLabel:)` (values per label). Show an empty state when there are no points.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify swift-charts-dashboard` on a Mac with Xcode.
